release_notes:
feat(orders): add "None" IMEI field type + fix false-success on empty IMEI

Adds a fifth IMEI Field Type, "None (Custom Fields Only)", for services
that take only custom fields and no IMEI/SN (e.g. case-history removal).
Such a service shows only its configured custom fields and places a single
order with an empty IMEINo. Existing types 0-3 are unchanged.

Also fixes a real bug: submitting an IMEI service with an empty/invalid
IMEI produced NO order but still redirected to success. The success
redirect is now gated on an order row actually being inserted
(ORDER_ACTUALLY_PLACED from mysqli_affected_rows); if nothing was placed
the user is returned to the order page with a clear error and no charge.

- services_tab_general.php: 5th radio (value 4).
- package.js: hide the Custom Field dropdown for the new radio.
- imeiorder.js: type 4 hides all IMEI inputs, shows only custom fields.
- submitimeiorder.php: type 4 places one order with empty IMEI; success
  redirect gated on actual placement.

(cherry picked from commit c422b191409ecddd499e6fae4c22bbeee60e441a)
